load the source registry (ADR-002: sources are data)
enforce: there is no default target (ADR-007)
steps.note: a None target handed out would be a refusal, not a substitution

steps.name: sweep expired leases + reclaim stale probes (ADR-039)
steps.note: zero on a fresh store is the correct measurement

steps.name: plan the scheduler over the store
discovery cycle: fetch ENABLED sources (live network)
normalize candidates (private/loopback/reserved dropped)
steps.note: the normalizer is the production one; drops are typed, not silent

steps.name: dedup against the pool by endpoint (ADR-040)
steps.note: endpoint-keyed (ADR-040); 0 on a fresh store is correct

steps.name: probe fresh candidates: TCP -> protocol -> k=5 sampling
steps.note: TCP triage -> empirical protocol discovery -> k=5 sampling

steps.name: admission gate on p95 of k samples (ADR-003)
steps.note: admitted=0 is a measurement of free-proxy reality, not a failure

steps.name: persist every verdict with reason codes (B-02)
serve N proxies via atomic lease (H3)
prove the leases as LEASED rows in the store
release accounting: one lease -> one release
crash recovery: SIGKILL a leasing child, pool stays consistent
steps.note: child holds a write transaction when it dies; WAL rolls it back, no row is lost or double-held. If the pool admitted nothing in step 11, the child leases 0 rows and this step proves store durability, not lease reclaim -- recorded, not dressed up.

steps.name: observability: counts by state + rejections by reason
